name: reliability
description: Mission Success Rate benchmark. Real desktop workflows a paying user would actually run, scored on VERIFIED business outcome against OS state — never step counts. The single KPI: how many finish, verified, unattended. WARNING: `run` takes over the real mouse/keyboard; run deliberately. Tasks are grouped by category; each failure becomes a tracked engineering task in docs/reliability-ledger.md.
